items.title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
items.summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys. The warning came in an email sent…

items.title: Passkeys Are Better Than Passwords. But They Are Not Enough.
items.summary: As organizations eliminate passwords, attackers will adapt. Instead of attacking the authenticator directly, they will look for opportunities around it. The post Passkeys Are Better Than Passwords. But They Are Not Enough. appeared first on SecurityWeek.
